about: Agent hook files per-user Setup writes, by connector and scope; {home} and {data_dir} stand for the account home and DefenseClaw data directory, {otlp_token}, {digest} and {time} for per-run values; agent_files are the files Setup writes beside them that register no hook. Written by TestEveryHookConnectorSetupMatchesTheSharedGolden (internal/gateway/connector); read by cli/tests/test_hook_registration_every_connector.py (GAP-0489).

files.content:
[hooks]
[[hooks.PermissionRequest]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.PermissionRequest.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PermissionRequest --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PostCompact]]
[[hooks.PostCompact.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PostCompact --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PostToolUse]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.PostToolUse.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PostToolUse --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PreCompact]]
[[hooks.PreCompact.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PreCompact --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.PreToolUse]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.PreToolUse.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event PreToolUse --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.SessionEnd]]
[[hooks.SessionEnd.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event SessionEnd --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 3
type = 'command'

[[hooks.SessionStart]]
matcher = 'startup|resume|clear|compact'

[[hooks.SessionStart.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event SessionStart --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.Stop]]
[[hooks.Stop.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event Stop --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 90
type = 'command'

[[hooks.SubagentStart]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.SubagentStart.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event SubagentStart --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[[hooks.SubagentStop]]
matcher = '*'

[[hooks.SubagentStop.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event SubagentStop --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 90
type = 'command'

[[hooks.UserPromptSubmit]]
[[hooks.UserPromptSubmit.hooks]]
command = '{data_dir}/hooks/codex-hook.sh --event UserPromptSubmit --hook-contract codex-hooks-v4'
timeout = 30
type = 'command'

[hooks.state]
[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:permission_request:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:post_compact:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:post_tool_use:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:pre_compact:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:pre_tool_use:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:session_end:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:session_start:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:stop:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:subagent_start:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:subagent_stop:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

[hooks.state.'{home}/.codex/config.toml:user_prompt_submit:0:0']
trusted_hash = 'sha256:{digest}'

hooks:
    api_request_error:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    kanban_task_blocked:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    kanban_task_claimed:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    kanban_task_completed:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    on_session_end:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    on_session_finalize:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    on_session_reset:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    on_session_start:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    post_api_request:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    post_approval_response:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    post_llm_call:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    post_tool_call:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          matcher: .*
          timeout: 30
    pre_api_request:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    pre_approval_request:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    pre_gateway_dispatch:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    pre_llm_call:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    pre_tool_call:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          fail_closed: true
          matcher: .*
          timeout: 30
    pre_verify:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    subagent_start:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    subagent_stop:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    transform_llm_output:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    transform_terminal_output:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
    transform_tool_result:
        - command: '''{data_dir}/hooks/hermes-hook.sh'''
          timeout: 30
